mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that may lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and higher costs for businesses, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negatively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment that negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rising, but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which can lead to higher consumer spending and positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 5%, but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% QoQ signals a weakening economy, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negatively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < -0.5% and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
